title: Only an explicit protected command invokes the real Companion model and creates a current proposal

given.plant: active, authorized, and populated through PostgreSQL with the committed evidence fixture
given.runtime: canonical companion and safety_gate each have one explicit real provider/model binding

when.command: the authorized actor posts one explicit Companion run request
when.non_triggers: feed reads, refresh, domain events, Task completion, and startup also occur

then.provider: the explicit command makes exactly one real Companion provider call and one real Safety classifier call; non-triggers make zero calls
then.governance: one matching classification and one current proposal with active attention are persisted
then.effects: no DecisionRecord, ordinary or action Task, Plant mutation, or device effect is created
